sections.heading: How does White-Label for Agencies work?
sections.html:
How does White-Label for Agencies work?

Your client sees your brand. You see ours.

Agencies come here when a client asks for a topical map, an AI visibility program, or semantic content. The agency has no strategist to build it. Every deliverable is produced in your template or ours with your name on it. We do not contact your client. You set the price.

sections.heading: What rules govern a White-Label Semantic SEO engagement?
sections.html:
What rules govern a White-Label Semantic SEO engagement?

  1. No client contactWe do not email, call, or join calls with your client unless you introduce us as a partner.
  2. Your pricingWholesale rates per deliverable. You set the client price.
  3. Your templates or oursDeliverables produced in your document and report templates when you supply them.
  4. One agency per end clientWe do not work for two agencies serving the same end client.
  5. Capacity booked aheadMonthly capacity blocks reserved per agency. Overflow is quoted, not squeezed.
  6. Non-disclosureA standing agreement covers every client you bring.

sections.heading: Questions about White-Label for Agencies
sections.html:
Questions about White-Label for Agencies

Does our client ever find out?Not from us. Every file, every report, and every outreach email carries your name or a neutral one. The only way they know is if you tell them.
What is the smallest white-label order?One project, or one monthly capacity block. No annual commitment applies.
Can we sit in on your process?Yes. The workshop, the brief QA, and the sentence checks are recorded. Some agencies use them to train their own team.
Is white-label work held to the same standard as your direct clients?Yes. Same pipeline, same checks, same editors. The white-label flag only changes the name on the file.
Do you take equity or revenue share?No. Wholesale rate per deliverable. Your margin is yours.
What access do you need to our client's site?The same access each service needs for a direct client, granted through your agency. Access requests go to you, never to your client.
How do we report progress to our client?Each deliverable arrives in your report format, ready to forward. Monthly services send their record each month under your name.
What if we disagree with a deliverable?Raise it with us before the deliverable goes to your client. Each decision carries its recorded reason, so the discussion stays on the reason.
Do you work in our client's language?Yes, in English, German, Spanish, and Italian. Native-language editors handle the German, Spanish, and Italian work.
Can the audit be the first white-label order for a new client?Yes. The Semantic Content Audit is delivered under your brand like every other deliverable. Your agency gets a written issue map to scope the next phase with the client.
